payload.title: Record every Reference's outbound links at capture
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-11-04. When a Reference is captured, store its outbound links, every kind of Reference. Stored only: nothing is followed by this story. Reference capture already parses anchors to find a better copy of the same document (reference_capture.py); keep what it finds. Separate main content links from navigation, footers and thanks, and keep that distinction, because followers use only content links. Capture fails or is thin: record what it has. Acceptance test page: https://blog.kjamistan.com/a-deep-dive-into-memorization-in-deep-learning.html, a 348-word hub with 23 links measured 2026-11-04: 17 series articles in an ordered list, 1 category page, 1 YouTube playlist, 3 people's thanks links (two personal sites, one LinkedIn). Expected on it: the 17 articles and the playlist are content links; the category page and thanks links are not.
